rulesStrings.li:
questDescription->[stellarch_nameFull] has reached the peak of what [stellarch_pronoun] can achieve from the surface of a rimworld. In order to progress further in the grand hierarchy and become the right hand of Emperor [emperor_nameFull], [stellarch_nameDef] needs to partake in a traditional ascension parade, after which [stellarch_pronoun] will depart on a shuttle and join the Emperor.

A parade of this magnitude is bound to draw the attention of deserters.

Once you accept this quest, you will have 5 days to prepare for the parade. Consider improving your defenses and working out contingency plans, as it is difficult to say which way the parade will move. At all times you will have to keep the parade safe from harm.

Keep an eye on any rivals or enemies of [stellarch_nameDef], as they might decide it’s a good time to make a move and claim the power for themselves.

The shuttle will arrive bringing the highest-ranking nobility to the parade. You will be responsible for providing the security for the event. After the parade starts, it will slowly move through the map for 12 hours, after which everyone, including [stellarch_nameDef], will board the shuttle and depart.
decidedToLeave->Your guests are leaving immediately, and will not remember this event fondly!
oneOfThe->one of the nobles visiting for the parade
CeremonyFailedLetterText->[asker_nameFull] is disappointed by your failure to make for an enjoyable parade. [asker_pronoun] is leaving with [asker_possessive] guests.
CeremonyTimeoutLetterText->[asker_nameFull] has grown tired of waiting for you to start the parade. [asker_pronoun] is leaving with [asker_possessive] guests.

NoblesArriveLetterText->[asker_nameFull] and the nobility for [stellarch_nameDef]'s ascension parade are landing. Once they have gathered, select [asker_nameDef] to start the parade. They will not wait long.
CountdownHostileLetterText->The Empire will not send its nobility to a colony it is at war with. [stellarch_nameDef]'s ascension parade is called off.
CountdownAwayLetterText->[asker_nameFull] waited a day for [stellarch_nameDef] to be at the colony to receive the nobility. The ascension parade is called off.
CountdownThreatLetterText->[asker_nameFull] waited a day for the danger at the colony to pass, and will not land the nobility into it. [stellarch_nameDef]'s ascension parade is called off.
letterIntroPsychicRitualTarget->{SUBJECT_definite}, [oneOfThe], was the target of a psychic ritual.
raidArrivedLetterText->A group of deserters have arrived to attempt to disrupt the parade and assassinate [stellarch_nameDef].\n\nThe parade must not be interrupted for any reason!
ParadeSuccessLetterText->The shuttle is ready to depart with all those ascending with [stellarch_nameDef]. It will depart upon your command!
